# Application Menu indicator - Takes Dock-requiring app menus and gives them a place to live in the panel.
Application Menu indicator is a Atayana Indicators library spec that provides a home for apps dependent on having detatched, dock-dependent sub-menus.

## Features
 - Home for detached, dock-dependent sub-mneus
 - Makes detatched sub-menus be usable
 - Aids user experience while using the Atayana Indicators stack
